properties.name: 気仙沼湾 (Kesennuma Bay)
properties.accuracy: approximate, traced from https://www.pref.miyagi.jp/documents/37871/kukakun.pdf (宮城海区漁場計画 令和5年一斉更新 区画漁業 北部, pages 2-3 '区画 No.2 唐桑西部' and '区画 No.3 気仙沼', CreationDate 2023-11-16)
properties.boundaryDefinition: 気仙沼湾（気仙沼市唐桑町御崎～気仙沼市波路上と気仙沼市本吉町との境)[from 807855.pdf]
properties.method: Vertices geocoded from place names printed on the source map (OpenStreetMap Nominatim; see pipeline/data/zones/sources.json), tracing the inner bay from Cape Osaki along the peninsula's bay-facing coast (Shibitachi, Maune) to Kesennuma port, then along the opposite shore to Iwaisaki at the Motoyoshi border, closed across the bay mouth. Simplified to a single ring that does not carve out Oshima island (the bay's real shape is split into two lobes by Oshima). Not surveyed; do not use for navigation or legal boundary purposes.
